hypotheses.mechanism: Research-Center-mediated shared state plus adaptive relevance routing lets ClayCode workers see current work, reuse results, partition overlap and route material deltas only to affected peers.
hypotheses.expected: Lower duplicate-work ratio and lower coordination-token cost than isolated workers or broadcast-all while preserving task completion and counterevidence propagation.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A center adds coordination latency and correlated decision errors; direct peer-to-peer or broad broadcast may outperform on some tasks.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched project replay shows no duplicate/cost reduction or worse correctness/conflict detection than alternatives.
hypotheses.next_test: Replay the same frozen ClayCode task pool under ISOLATED, BROADCAST_ALL and CENTER_RELEVANCE_ROUTED topologies; measure duplicate work, token/message cost, stale work, unresolved conflicts, completion latency and correctness.

hypotheses.mechanism: Mandatory center reread plus CAS/revalidation before semantic commit prevents stale workers from silently overwriting concurrent work.
hypotheses.expected: Concurrent conflicts become explicit invalidation/merge events rather than last-writer-wins state loss.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Git-level CAS alone is sufficient and Research Center reread adds no useful information.
hypotheses.falsifier: Concurrent multiworker trials show center reread detects no additional stale semantic/dependency conflicts beyond raw Git CAS and only adds cost.
hypotheses.current_evidence: This run encountered a real GitHub 409 concurrent write conflict while attempting to change CLAYCODE_RELEASE_WORKSPACE.json; the stale write was not forced.
hypotheses.next_test: Controlled two-worker conflicting semantic update experiment with dependency-aware center state vs Git CAS only.

hypotheses.mechanism: Explicit independent-replication intent preserves valuable replication while default duplicate suppression removes accidental duplicate work.
hypotheses.expected: Lower accidental duplication without loss of independent replication coverage.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Workers misclassify replication intent or dedup suppresses serendipitous independent solutions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Replay shows materially fewer independent counterexamples or higher correlated-error persistence after deduplication.
hypotheses.next_test: Seed hidden counterexamples into matched worker teams and compare discovery under unrestricted duplication vs explicit REPLICATOR lanes.

hypotheses.mechanism: The prior ClayCode type_expr grammar lacked union types even though current Research Center contracts use union-typed record fields.
hypotheses.expected: Strict parser rejects center fields containing | under the old grammar and accepts them after a minimal type-union grammar extension.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The existing grammar already accepts those fields without change.
hypotheses.falsifier: A conforming parser using the old grammar accepts the union-typed fields.
hypotheses.current_evidence: Local executable test rejected 2/2 union-field cases under the old grammar; repaired grammar passed 8/8 targeted cases.
